text: Select: assay.chembl_id, target_dictionary.target_type, target_dictionary.tax_id, compound_structures.canonical_smiles, molecule_dictionary.chembl_id, activities.standard_type, activities.pchembl_value. Source: activities, assays, target_dictionary, molecule_dictionary, compound_structures. Join: activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id, assays.tid = target_dictionary.tid, activities.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno, molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno. Filter: target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1293197', activities.standard_type = 'IC50', activities.standard_relation = '=', activities.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL. Sort: molecule_dictionary.chembl_id ASC, assays.chembl_id ASC. Limit: 1000.
